resources.string: Point the top of the phone at the TV, or join the TV\'s Wi-Fi to skip pointing
Connected to %1$s over Wi-Fi · no need to point
Looking for the TV on Wi-Fi… Connect this phone to the same Wi-Fi as the TV.
Connecting to the TV at %1$s over Wi-Fi… Tap to change the address.
Point the phone at the TV, or wait: connecting to it at %1$s over Wi-Fi… Tap to change.
Playing the TV\'s sound on this phone · tap the headphones to stop
Connect to the TV over Wi-Fi first (the line at the top turns green).
In this phone\'s headphones. Tap Stop to end.

The TV\'s sound plays at its best on wired earphones or this phone\'s speaker, and Bluetooth slows down the Wi-Fi it comes over. So CouchTV Remote keeps Bluetooth off while you use it.\n\nTo do that, it needs “Nearby devices”: allow it on the next screen.
Bluetooth is off while CouchTV Remote is in use, for the best sound
Bluetooth is still on. Turn it off for the best TV sound.
Turn Bluetooth off here for the best TV sound
%1$s is on this Wi-Fi. Tap here to pair this phone with it (once), so it works without pointing.
The TV needs the latest CouchTV to work over Wi-Fi: press F6 on the TV to update it.
Type the 6-digit code shown on the TV.
Another phone is pairing with the TV right now. Try again in a minute.
Too many wrong codes, so the TV is not pairing for now. Try again in %1$d min.
That wasn\'t the code on the TV. Tap Try again for a new one.
The TV\'s answer didn\'t check out, so this phone didn\'t pair: someone on the Wi-Fi may be interfering. Try again.
Couldn\'t reach the TV to pair. Check this phone is on the same Wi-Fi, then try again.
The TV PC\'s IP address on your Wi-Fi. The TV shows it under Settings & power > Remote. If it doesn\'t answer, the app searches the network instead.
This phone has no IR blaster, so it can\'t send to the TV.
This phone\'s IR blaster can\'t send at 38 kHz, so the TV may not hear it.
Microphone. Tap to finish, or to try again.
Didn\'t catch that. Tap the mic to try again.
Voice search needs the internet. Tap the mic to try again.
Voice input isn\'t available on this phone, so type instead.
Sending “%1$s” to the TV… keep pointing at it
Can\'t reach the TV\'s receiver box on the Wi-Fi, and this phone has no IR blaster. Pair this phone with the TV (tap the line at the top) for Power over Wi-Fi.
The TV PC is asleep or off (the TV is %1$s). Press Power to switch both on.
Slide to move, tap to click, tap twice and slide to drag. Two fingers: slide to scroll, tap to right-click.
Connect to the TV over Wi-Fi first
It changes on the TV as you pick. Over a link it turns blue (yellow, if the pointer is blue).
Connect to the TV over Wi-Fi to change its pointer
Shift, Ctrl, Alt and Win stay on for the next key: tap twice to keep them on. Type uses this phone\'s own keyboard.
Connect to the TV over Wi-Fi first
Add buttons that send your own codes, then teach them to the TV.
After saving, teach the TV what it does: Settings & power > Remote on the TV, or a line in remote.ini.
Installing… the app restarts when it\'s done
the download was damaged; try again
no build has been published yet
To install its own updates, CouchTV Remote needs your permission once. On the next screen, turn on “Allow from this source”, then come back and tap Update again.

“%1$s” sends %2$s.

On the TV, open Settings & power > Remote and press this button when you reach the action you want. Or add a line to remote.ini, for example:

%2$s = key:M
